## Source 1 — TikTok Shop OTDR revision (June 8, 2026): "seller's fault" definition narrowed, appeal channel added

**Type:** Industry news (TT123卖家导航 + idcspy.com + yiofong.com — republishing TikTok Shop merchant notices)
**Headline:** "TikTok Shop美区6月8日起调整履约考核规则" / "TikTok Shop严控延迟发货!最高或按单5美元赔付"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "TikTok Shop美区自2026年6月8日起对订单履约合规考核进行四项重要调整:1. 取消'物流派送延迟'单独扣分。只要卖家按时完成首段扫描(订单在2个工作日内更新为'运输中'),后续因承运商中转、分拣或末端派送延误将不再计入卖家罚分。2. 新增'寄件扫描延迟(漏扫)'申诉通道。若物流商揽收后未及时完成首段扫描导致被判定延迟发货,卖家可凭加盖物流商签章的揽收交接单或带时间戳的现场照片等证据发起申诉,并移除计分。3. 按时发货及首段扫描(LDR)的2个工作日硬要求保持不变。4. 按时送达率(OTDR)计算口径修正,仅统计卖家可控环节(发货速度、首段扫描时效),末端不可控延误不再影响指标。"
> "每个延迟发货订单,商家需向平台支付5美元损害赔偿金。要知道当前TikTok美区小店平均利润率仅8-15个点,很多低价单品的利润都不到5美元,一旦延迟,相当于'卖一单亏一单'。"
> "限流机制分级化:平台引入'延迟履约率(LDR)'红线,一旦超标直接限单:延迟率10%-20%,订单量限至此前日均的50%;20%-40%限至30%;40%-60%限至20%;60%以上直接砍至10%。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "漏扫" (missed first-scan) — the carrier-side failure mode that became a seller-side penalty
- "申诉通道" (appeal channel) — finally a procedural remedy, but requires physical evidence
- "末端不可控延误" (end-leg uncontrollable delays) — the gap that was always counted against sellers
- "结算账期延长31天" / "卖一单亏一单" — cash-flow + unit-economics collapse
- "罚款金额明确化" / "限流机制分级化" — the three-headed enforcement that still stands

### Why this works:
The freshest Pillar 1 story of the cycle. The June 8 revision is the FIRST signal that TikTok Shop is willing to narrow what counts as seller-fault. That is a regime change — and the operator who already wired their fulfillment architecture around the old "all delay = penalty" rule is now sitting on needless margin protection costs. The verbatim "末端不可控延误不再影响指标" line is the load-bearing hook. The narrative: "TikTok just admitted the carrier is the bottleneck. If you're still routing through USPS because the rate card was a dollar cheaper, you've been over-paying for risk you didn't create." The LDR hard-2-business-days requirement (still standing) is the constraint to anchor the optimization playbook.

## Source 2 — TikTok Shop's mandatory FBT shift (Feb 9, 2026): Seller-shipping sunset for new sellers, March 31 deadline for existing

**Type:** Industry news (yiofong.com / idcspy.com / unicargo.com / bytestand.com / stacksync.com — all republishing TikTok Shop merchant notices)
**Headline:** "TikTok Shop美国站取消卖家自发货模式" / "TikTok Shop & Amazon MCF after February 2026"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "按照新政策,自2026年初起,卖家只能使用 TikTok Shop Logistics Services,包括 Fulfilled by TikTok(FBT)、Upgraded TikTok Shipping 以及 Collections by TikTok(CBT)。该政策同时适用于在美国本土运营的卖家,以及位于美国以外、但向美国市场销售的跨境卖家。对于已入驻卖家,政策将于2026年2月25日至3月31日期间分阶段实施;而在2026年2月9日及之后新入驻的卖家,则从上线之初即必须使用 TikTok 管理的物流体系。"
> "Sellers onboarding on or after February 9, 2026 (PST) are required to fulfill all orders exclusively through TikTok Shop Logistics Services."
> "TikTok Shop officially confirmed MCF as a supported fulfillment method in February 2026, clearing up months of policy uncertainty. Shopify has a free, Amazon- ..."

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "卖家自发货" sunset — the only path many sellers used for unusual SKUs (oversize, hazmat, temp-controlled)
- "FBT增量返现激励(2026年4月–9月)" — the carrot; 10% rebate on incremental FBT volume
- "已入驻卖家" vs "新入驻卖家" — split rollout that doubles complexity for agencies managing portfolios
- "3PL未获得平台原生支持" — the unrecoverable integration gap for sellers on legacy 3PLs

### Why this works:
The textbook Pillar 1 angle — a hard platform mandate that forces a re-platform of the fulfillment stack. The math: a seller doing 20K orders/month at 12% margin loses $40K/month in profit if their 3PL integration breaks the SLA on a single day. The narrative: "this is not an ops migration, it's a margin event." The Feb 9 vs Feb 25–March 31 split rollout is the persona-anchored complexity lever — operators managing 10+ seller accounts can't templatize the playbook. The Amazon MCF escape hatch (unicargo confirms it) is the work-around the persona's "outcomes over software" framework needs to surface.
